versions.content: If the configuration parameter CanIfPublicReadRxPdu- DataApi is set to TRUE, CanIf shall store each received L-SDU , at which CanI- fRxPduReadData is enabled, into a receive L-SDU buffer. This means that if the con- figuration parameter CanIfRxPduReadData is set to TRUE , CanIf has to allocate a receive L-SDU buffer for this receive L-SDU .
